title: Best Dehumidifier for Bedroom (2026): Quiet & Small Picks
h1: The Best Quiet Dehumidifiers for Bedrooms
dek: A dehumidifier three feet from your pillow has to dry the air without stealing your sleep. These are the quiet, right-sized ones.
description: The best dehumidifier for a bedroom: quiet sleep-mode and near-silent mini units that hold 45–50% overnight, plus where to put one and how long to run it.
intro: The best **dehumidifier for a bedroom** has a different job description from a basement workhorse. It has to be quiet enough to sleep beside, dim enough not to light up the ceiling, and hold enough water to make it to morning. A basement unit can roar all afternoon; a bedroom unit needs a real sleep mode or no compressor at all.

Getting it right is worth the effort. You spend roughly a third of your life in this one room, and humidity above about 50% is where dust mites thrive, according to the American Lung Association. Holding the bedroom near **45%** makes it less friendly to mites and mold without drying out your throat.

We compared quiet and small dehumidifiers on sleep-mode features, published noise ratings, tank size, humidistat control and capacity, then matched them to bedrooms of different sizes and dampness levels.
topPicksLead: The **Midea Cube 35-Pint** is the best bedroom dehumidifier for most people, pairing a quiet sleep mode with a tank that easily lasts the night.

products.name: Midea Cube 35-Pint Smart Dehumidifier (MAD35S1QWT)
pros: Sleep mode slows the fan and dims the display
Oversized nested reservoir rarely fills overnight
Holds a set humidity instead of cycling on high
products.whyWeLoveIt: It solves the three bedroom problems at once: noise, light and a 3 a.m. full-bucket beep. Set a target and the smart humidistat holds it smoothly, rather than roaring on and off through the night.
products.performance: It's rated at 35 pints a day under the DOE 2019 test, which is plenty for a large or damp primary bedroom. The collapsing cube reservoir holds far more than a standard bucket, and the app lets you adjust settings without getting up. For smaller rooms, the same design comes in a 20-pint size; see our [best Midea dehumidifier](/best/best-midea-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Costway 32-Pint Dehumidifier (2,000 Sq. Ft.)
pros: Real capacity for a large or damp primary bedroom
Three modes and two fan speeds
Owners often mention quiet running for its size
cons: Generous coverage claim for its size
products.whyWeLoveIt: If you want dependable extraction without paying for smart features, this is the no-nonsense pick. It lands squarely in the 30-pint class and still includes a timer and child lock that some budget models skip.
products.performance: Costway rates it at 32 pints a day for up to 2,000 square feet. That coverage claim is generous for a unit this size, so treat it as a strong machine for one large or damp primary bedroom rather than a whole-floor solution. Owners often mention quiet running for its size, but it's still a compressor unit, so place it across the room from the bed and use the lower fan speed overnight. More budget picks are in our [best budget dehumidifier](/best/best-budget-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Frigidaire 22-Pint Dehumidifier (FFAD2233W1)
pros: Compact compressor unit right-sized for one room
cons: Too small for a large, damp room
products.whyWeLoveIt: A small, mildly damp bedroom doesn't need a 50-pint box humming in the corner. This is a genuine compressor unit scaled down to 22 pints, so it dries efficiently without dominating the room.
products.performance: It's rated at 22 pints a day under the DOE test, which suits a guest room, kid's room or small primary bedroom. The filter slides out for rinsing and the drain option keeps it from overflowing overnight. See the full lineup in our [best Frigidaire dehumidifier](/best/best-frigidaire-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: AirPlus Max 30 Pint Tall Dehumidifier
pros: Quiet sleep mode for overnight running
Sized for bedrooms and mid-size rooms
cons: Marketed capacity, not a DOE 2019 figure
products.whyWeLoveIt: It's designed with bedrooms in mind. When the dehumidifier runs in the room where you sleep, a dedicated sleep mode matters more than a few extra pints, and the drain hose means it won't stop in the middle of the night with a full tank.
products.performance: AirPlus sizes it for up to 1,500 square feet and pitches it for bedrooms, large rooms and campers, with a quiet sleep mode and a drain hose. In practice, it's a comfortable fit for a single damp bedroom of a few hundred square feet. Because AirPlus doesn't publish decibel figures, compare it with the picks in our [best quiet dehumidifier](/best/best-quiet-dehumidifier/) guide if quiet is your top priority.

products.name: Pro Breeze PB-03 Mini Dehumidifier (2,200 cu ft)

Small enough for a nightstand or shelf

products.whyWeLoveIt: For a light sleeper, a nursery or a small room that's only a little humid, nothing beats the quiet of a thermoelectric mini. There's no compressor to kick on in the middle of the night.
products.performance: Pro Breeze rates it for 2,200 cubic feet, roughly a small bedroom with a standard ceiling. It won't rescue a damp room, but it keeps a mildly humid one comfortable. For baby rooms specifically, our [best dehumidifier for nursery](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-nursery/) guide covers more options.

items.label: Smart overnight target, inside the EPA's 30–50% range
A sensible noise ceiling for a unit on its sleep setting
Capacity range that fits most bedrooms (DOE 2019 ratings)

blocks.text: If you're torn between sizes, go one step up. A slightly larger unit can run on a lower, quieter fan speed to hold the same humidity a smaller one would have to work hard for.

We don't sleep next to test units with sound meters. We compared manufacturer noise ratings and sleep-mode features, DOE 2019 capacity ratings, tank sizes, humidistat type and ENERGY STAR data, and read owner reviews for complaints that matter at night: rattling compressors, bright displays, loud beeps and units that cycle abruptly.
Quiet operation carried the most weight, then a tank or drain setup that lasts the night, then a humidistat that holds a set number.

sections.heading: What to look for in a quiet dehumidifier for a bedroom

items.label: A true sleep mode
items.text: It should lower the fan, dim or switch off the display and silence beeps — not just one of the three.

items.label: The right size
items.text: 20–22 pints for a small, mildly damp room; 30–35 for a large or humid one. Our [dehumidifier size guide](/guides/dehumidifier-size-guide/) has details.

items.label: A tank that lasts the night
items.text: A big reservoir or a drain hose means no full-bucket alarm at 3 a.m.

items.label: A set-percentage humidistat
items.text: Holding 45–50% smoothly is quieter than running full blast and shutting off.

items.label: Compressor or thermoelectric?
items.text: Compressor units remove much more water; thermoelectric minis are nearly silent but suit only small, lightly humid rooms.

sections.heading: Best place to put a dehumidifier in a bedroom

items: **Across the room from the bed,** so fan noise and airflow aren't aimed at your head.
**Six to 12 inches from walls and furniture,** so air can circulate freely around the intake and exhaust.
**Away from closets and curtains** that block airflow, but near the dampest spot, such as an exterior wall.
**On a hard, level surface** or a tray if the floor is carpeted or wood.
**With doors and windows closed** while it runs, or it will try to dry the whole outdoors.

blocks.text: Our guide on [where to place a dehumidifier](/guides/where-to-place-a-dehumidifier/) covers other rooms, too.

sections.heading: How long to run a dehumidifier in a bedroom

blocks.text: Let the humidistat decide. Set it to 45–50% and leave it on automatic; it will run as long as the room needs and then idle. In a damp room, expect long run times for the first day or two, then shorter cycles once the bedding, carpet and walls dry out. If it runs nonstop for days without reaching the target, the unit is probably undersized or a door or window is letting humid air in.

blocks.title: Benefits of a dehumidifier in the bedroom
blocks.text: Lower humidity can make a warm night feel cooler, reduce dust mites and mold, cut musty odors and help bedding feel fresher. For allergy-focused advice, see our [best dehumidifier for dust mites](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-dust-mites/) guide.

The **Midea Cube 35-Pint** is the best bedroom dehumidifier for most people: quiet, smart and roomy enough to last the night. The **Costway 32-Pint** is the value pick for a large room, the **Frigidaire FFAD2233W1** fits a small bedroom, the **AirPlus Max 30** is built around a quiet sleep mode, and the near-silent **Pro Breeze PB-03** is the choice for light sleepers and nurseries. Whatever you pick, hold the room around 45–50%.

faqs.q: What is the best dehumidifier for a bedroom?
faqs.a: The Midea Cube 35-Pint for most bedrooms, thanks to its sleep mode, large reservoir and smart humidistat. For a small bedroom or a light sleeper, the near-silent Pro Breeze PB-03 thermoelectric mini is the quieter pick.

faqs.q: What is the best small dehumidifier for a bedroom?
faqs.a: For a small but genuinely damp bedroom, the Frigidaire FFAD2233W1 22-pint compressor unit. If the room is only a little humid and quiet matters most, the compact Pro Breeze PB-03 fits on a nightstand and runs almost silently.

faqs.q: Should you run a dehumidifier in the bedroom all night?
faqs.a: Yes, if the room is damp. Set the humidistat to 45–50% and the unit will cycle as needed. A full-tank auto-shutoff or drain hose makes overnight running safe.

faqs.q: How quiet should a bedroom dehumidifier be?
faqs.a: Aim for around 45 dBA or lower on the sleep or low setting, roughly the hush of a quiet library. Thermoelectric minis are quieter still because they have no compressor.

faqs.q: How do you dehumidify a bedroom?
faqs.a: Start by closing windows on humid days, running the AC in summer and venting moisture from an attached bathroom. Then add a right-sized dehumidifier set to 45–50%, and check the result with a hygrometer.

faqs.q: Does a bedroom dehumidifier help with allergies?
faqs.a: It can. Dust mites thrive above about 50% humidity, so holding the bedroom near 45% makes it much less hospitable. Pair it with regular hot washing of bedding for the best results.
